description: Macro structure. The engine maps any chapter number to an arc, and an arc to its promises, pressures, and licensed expansions.

arcs.name: Entrance by the Side Door
arcs.promise: A person with nothing gets one impossible chance.
arcs.central_question: Can Kestrel survive a place built to exclude them?
arcs.closes_on: Kestrel passes the threshold test but only by breaking a rule nobody has caught yet.

arcs.name: The Ledgerhouse Notices
arcs.promise: Competence attracts patronage, and patronage has terms.
arcs.central_question: What is Kestrel willing to sign?
arcs.closes_on: The first signature. The first person harmed by it.

arcs.name: Reach Exceeds Grasp
arcs.promise: The world is larger than the city, and it has already been divided.
arcs.central_question: Is Kestrel an actor or an instrument?
arcs.closes_on: A decision made at scale that kills people Kestrel will never meet.

arcs.name: The Break
arcs.promise: The thing that made Kestrel survive is the thing now destroying them.
arcs.central_question: Who is Kestrel without the ledger?
arcs.closes_on: The lie breaks in public. Kestrel loses the standing they built.

arcs.name: Unearned Ground
arcs.promise: Rebuilding on a different foundation, at a cost that cannot be itemized.
arcs.central_question: Can something be given rather than owed?
